sentences.en: Juha loaded salt on his donkey.
The donkey fell in the water and the salt melted.
The load became light and the donkey was happy.

sentences.ar: المرة الجاي، الحمار وقع بالمي بالقصد.
sentences.en: The next time, the donkey fell in the water on purpose.

sentences.ar: بس هاي المرة كان شايل صوف.
sentences.en: But this time it was carrying wool.

sentences.ar: الصوف شرب المي وصار تقيل كتير.
sentences.en: The wool drank the water and became very heavy.

sentences.ar: قال جحا: كل شغلة إلها وقتها.
sentences.en: Juha said: everything has its time.
